Name: Don't Eat That
Author: Pyrohead37
Description:
[size=5]UPDATED FOR THE MULTIPLAYER VERSION

Description:
[/size][size=3]Tired of constantly canceling the eating prompt when you didn't mean for it to appear? Do you want to turn your brain off while refilling a room full of kegs or preserves? To run around with an egg above your head while smashing the action button down with listless abandon like a blissful, brainless ape?

Me too.

This simple quality of life mod allows you to specify items that you don't want to be prompted to eat. Because really, who would [i]ever[/i] want to chow down on tree sap?

[size=5]Install:[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Check the readme and change [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] to your liking. The items excluded by default are animal products and harmful stuff.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Enjoy your life a bit more.
[/list][/size]
[size=5]Notes:
[/size][size=3]I haven't tested this mod with custom items, but if they're injected into Content\Data\ObjectInformation.xnb [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:SMAPI_APIs#Inject_assets]using the process outlined here[/url]﻿ then I imagine it will work as long as that happens before this mod is loaded. It avoids triggering the animation code at all so it should work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1089]Fast Animations[/url].


[b][color=#6aa84f]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.2+ on Linux, Mac, and Windows. Requires SMAPI 2.9 or later.[/color][/b][/size]
